subject: Future Tech
title: Google DeepMind
description: A short lesson to help you apply Google DeepMind.

hook.text: DeepMind created AlphaGo, AlphaFold, and Gemini.

buildup.text: DeepMind merged with Google Brain in 2023, consolidating Google's AI talent.

discovery.text: AlphaFold predicted the structure of every known protein—200 million structures.

twist.text: Despite research leadership, DeepMind was slow to market. OpenAI shipped ChatGPT first and seized public mindshare.

climax.text: Gemini Ultra competes with GPT-4. Google is catching up commercially while maintaining its research edge.

punchline.text: The best research lab in AI, now learning to race to market too.

quiz.question: What was AlphaFold's major achievement?
options: Predicting the structure of 200 million proteins
